title: Identity / Imagery introduction
slide_intent: Distinguish the jobs of illustration and photography because a visual system needs both a recognizable style and a connection to real people.
strategic_value: Illustration can carry Duolingo’s signature while photography represents the diversity of its learners.
demonstration: The imagery introduction names illustration as a key identity element and photography as a way to show people learning.
practical_value: Choose the medium according to whether the communication needs character-led expression or real-person representation.
